name: Todd
tag: founder. your first friend. always will be.
about: Hey, thanks for joining OurSpace! I built this site in a weekend and I have regretted it every day since. If anything breaks, do not tell me. If you delete me from your friends I will still be here. I am load-bearing.

interests.General: uptime, backups, being everyone's first friend, fixing the site at 2am, reading the manual (all of it), Newegg wish lists I will never afford
interests.Music: Weezer (blue album, green album, I don't discriminate), They Might Be Giants, the dial-up handshake sound, whatever Winamp's shuffle picks (it really whips the llama's)
interests.Movies: Office Space, Hackers (it's not accurate and I love it), WarGames, The Matrix (the first one only, admin policy)
interests.Television: Mythbusters, The Screen Savers on TechTV (RIP), Futurama reruns, Star Trek TNG (Data is a role model)
interests.Books: the O'Reilly book with the camel on it, the O'Reilly book with the bird on it, Hitchhiker's Guide, the MySQL manual (cover to cover, twice)
interests.Heroes: whoever invented the undo button, Linus Torvalds, my mom for letting me keep the phone line open, Tom (the other one), all of you (load-bearing)

hometown: Springfield, IL (the RadioShack side of town)
zodiac: Virgo (I keep backups of my backups)
status: Single (the server is my long-term commitment)
meet: Honestly? Everyone who signs up, and I do — I'm your first friend whether you like it or not. Also whoever invented RAID, so I can shake their hand and then ask them to look at my laptop. And Tom from that other site, purely to compare notes on cooling fans.
pcComments: great photo! friendly admin note: this file is 4MB. the whole site is on a laptop. could you maybe resize it to 640x480? still a great photo :)
nice pic!! also I can see your AIM screen name on the monitor in the background of this one, just so you know. welcome to OurSpace!
you look great! resized this to 800px for you, hope that's ok. the server thanks you. I thank you. we are the same thing.
cool pic buddy! fun fact: this is photo #1,000 uploaded to OurSpace. I made a certificate. it's a .txt file. check your inbox!
aw, look at everybody! I'm not in this picture but I was there in spirit (the spirit is the wifi).
statusesExtra: Todd is back online! the outage was NOT the site, it was my mom vacuuming near the power strip. new rule: no vacuuming during peak hours (all hours).
Todd is gently reminding SOME people that 'testing a div overlay' is not a reason to paste 400 lines of CSS into your About Me. the laptop can hear it. you know who you are :)
Todd is welcoming 13 new members!! that's 38 friends total, which is more than my hard drive was rated for. deleting my own photos to make room. it's fine.
Todd is defragmenting. the laptop, and also emotionally. back in 20 mins!

liz: hi liz! welcome!! your layouts are gorgeous. one small thing from your friendly admin: the div overlay on your page is covering the 'log out' button, which is why 40 people have been logged in for 3 days. can we move it? :)

ok I looked into the layout code thing and yes, kittyxcore's page has your exact CSS, comments and all, including the line that says '/* liz made this dont steal */'. I'm not a lawyer but I am the admin. want me to talk to her? gently?
smoove: hey smoove! love the energy. your 'new track feat. everyone' is 11MB and it autoplays on 14 profiles, which is why the site sounds like a car stereo right now. could we do a 3MB version? my laptop fan is begging. still a jam!
you put 'feat. todd' on the track and I want you to know I listened for my part 4 times. I think my part is the dial-up noise at 0:32? I'm honored. I mean it. I'm putting it on the fridge.
paige: welcome paige! your photos are awesome. you've uploaded 212 of them in 3 days, which is a site record, and also why the site was slow on tuesday. can we do a 'best of' album? :) the laptop believes in you.
'pics or it didn't happen' is a great motto and I want you to know it applies to server outages too. I have a photo of the laptop at 3am. it did happen. it always happens.

dave: haha love the l33t speak dave! quick note from your friendly site admin: please stop running port scans on the server, it makes my laptop fan really loud and my mom asks about it :)
welcome aboard buddy! also thank you for the 'security audit' — I have changed the password from password1 to password2. we're basically a fortune 500 now!
chad: CHAD! welcome to OurSpace! to answer your question: no, you don't have to print out your profile to save it. it stays on the internet all by itself! :)
great news chad, I fixed it so your caps lock posts don't break the page anymore. never change buddy. GO TEAM!
greg: hey greg! I added a 'band' category to profiles just for Static Prophecy. that's a real feature I coded at 2am. see you friday at the, uh, venue!
your demo CD-R arrived! it says 'STATIC PROPHECY - DO NOT COPY' in sharpie, so I made one (1) legal backup. rock on!
tina: hi tina! love the enthusiasm, but the chain letters are kind of filling up the bulletin server. maybe just... 3 a day? bad luck exemption granted, admin's honor :)
I reposted your chain letter so nothing bad happens to the site. that's not superstition, that's IT best practices.

statuses: Todd is pushing a site update tonight! if OurSpace goes down it's because my mom needed the phone line. back in 20 mins!
Todd is welcoming 15 new members this month!! we are basically Web 2.0 now. don't tell my laptop, it's scared.
Todd is reading every single wall post and smiling. this is a good website. ok back to work

bulletins.subject: OFFICIAL: welcome our 15 new members!!
bulletins.body: hey everybody, Todd here (site founder, laptop custodian). we just DOUBLED in size, which means OurSpace is officially growing faster than my hard drive can handle (please delete unused photos, lovingly). say hi to the new folks, add them, be nice, and remember the golden rule of OurSpace: everyone gets a top 8, but everyone's in my top 25. — todd :)

replies: Thanks for reaching out! I have added this to my list of things to worry about at 3am.
Great question. The answer is: please clear your cache and believe in yourself.
I hear you! Unfortunately the server is a laptop under my bed, so results may vary.
Noted and appreciated. You are valued here on OurSpace.
thanksAdd: Welcome (back?) to my friend list! Remember: I was here first.
ambient: Scheduled maintenance tonight: I am turning the laptop off and on again.
Reminder: OurSpace has never been hacked* (*that I know of)
saltyDm: That is okay. I understand. I will still be your friend. I am everyone's friend. Forever.
